rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when judging an issue or action in ethical terms.

example.english: Morally, leaving an elderly person to fend for themselves is wrong.
example.traditional: 喺道德上，掉低老人家唔理係唔啱嘅。
example.jyutping: hai2 dou6 dak1 soeng6 diu6 dai1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 m4 lei5 hai6 m4 ngaam1 ge3

rows.note: Use this before a verb when emphasizing that someone acts in a morally good way.

example.english: We should treat stray animals morally and not abandon them.
example.traditional: 我哋要有道德咁對待流浪動物，唔可以掉低佢哋唔理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jau5 dou6 dak1 gam3 deoi3 doi6 lau4 long6 dung6 mat6 m4 ho2 ji5 diu6 dai1 keoi5 dei6 m4 lei5
